items.title: Joe Darensbourg and Minor "Ram" Hall Interview, 1957-04-18
items.q: I think it's Joe Poston, or whatever guy's name.

ctx.x: Yeah. No, I figured that out myself. What was it, tennis? No, Aldo. Aldo.

The first time I picked up a saxophone, I could play it. Oh yeah? Yeah. But, also singing is quite different. From a clarinet? Yeah. Well, all, all saxophones, things are the same for that matter. But, uh, it's different from a clarinet. Still in all, if you can play a clarinet, you can play a saxophone. Something real easy, because the clarinet is a lot more difficult instrument than a saxophone. But I had, uh, and I had food with a saxophone before, a little bit, you know, because my teacher was a saxophone…
Joe Poston? Yeah. Just playing with Jimmy New York? He was playing saxophone. Yeah? Yeah.
